## Libraries

```{r libraries}

library(ggplot2) # plots
ggplot2::theme_set(theme_light())
library(ggpubr)  # ggarrange

```

## Procrustes ANOVA
The output of the Procrustes ANOVA from MorphoJ. Some values, which in the output were rounded to 0, were extracted from Lasius-niger.morphoj file.

```{r morphoj}

txt <- readLines("Procrustes-ANOVA.txt")
cat(txt, sep = "\n")

```

## Read data

```{r data}

dataIn = read.csv("Lasius-niger-asymmetry.csv", sep = ";")
dataIn$colony = factor(dataIn$colony)

# convert meters to milimeters
dataIn$CS = dataIn$CS * 1000
dataIn$CSasym = dataIn$CSasym * 1000

# calculate absolute and relative size asymmetry
dataIn$absCSasym = abs(dataIn$CSasym)
dataIn$relCSasym = 100 * dataIn$absCSasym/dataIn$CS

# number of individuals
nrow(dataIn)
# number of females and males
table(dataIn$sex)

```

## Signed size asymmetry
Males have larger signed wing size asymmetry than females.

```{r singedCS}

fit = lm(CSasym ~ sex + colony, dataIn)
anova(fit)
figA = ggplot(dataIn, aes(x = sex, y = CSasym)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = sex), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(F = "red", M = "blue")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(F = "Females", M = "Males")) +
  labs(x = "Sex", y = "\nSigned size asymmetry (mm)") +
  guides(fill = "none")
figA

```

## Absolute size asymmetry
Females have larger absolute wing size asymmetry than males.

```{r absCS}

fit = lm(absCSasym ~ sex + colony, dataIn)
anova(fit)
figB = ggplot(dataIn, aes(x = sex, y = absCSasym)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = sex), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(F = "red", M = "blue")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(F = "Females", M = "Males")) +
  labs(x = "Sex", y = "\nAbsolute size asymmetry (mm)") +
  guides(fill = "none")
figB

```

## Relative size asymmetry
There is no difference in relative wing size asymmetry between females and males.

```{r relCS}

fit = lm(relCSasym ~ sex + colony, dataIn)
anova(fit)
figC = ggplot(dataIn, aes(x = sex, y = relCSasym)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = sex), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(F = "red", M = "blue")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(F = "Females", M = "Males")) +
  labs(x = "Sex", y = "\nRelative size asymmetry (%)") +
  guides(fill = "none")
figC

```

## Shape asymmetry
Fluctuating asymmetry of wing shape is larger in males than in females.

```{r shape}

# wing shape asymmetry is smaller in females than in males
fit = lm(shapeFA ~ sex + colony, dataIn)
anova(fit)
figD = ggplot(dataIn, aes(x = sex, y = shapeFA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = sex), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(F = "red", M = "blue")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(F = "Females", M = "Males")) +
  labs(x = "Sex", y = "\nShape asymmetry") +
  guides(fill = "none")
figD

```

## Combined plot

```{r fig}

ggarrange(figA, figB, figC, figD, 
          labels = c("a", "b", "c", "d"), 
          font.label = list(size = 12, face = "bold"),
          ncol = 2, nrow = 2)

```
